text:
maria.dev: seeing a spike of 'critical-pager' alerts that never rang the oncall phones. first observed ~5m ago, looks like deliveries returned 502 from pager gateway
incident-bot: automated: paging attempt failed for rule `critical-pager` — 502 Bad Gateway from pager-gateway (3/3 vendors). message_id=pm_8a7f; retry_policy=postback
kevin-ops: thanks — can you paste the gateway logs? suspecting postback loop or signing proxy returning 502
zara-sre: grabbing logs now. quick grep shows repeated POST /v1/postback -> 502 from notify-relay: `upstream read timeout` in the relay pods
sam-oncall: i never got the ring. slack shows me as available, PD shows me 'unregistered' for the rotation though — weird
kevin-ops: hmm. that explains ghosting. if PD thinks you're unregistered automation won't page you. does PD UI show a recent webhook error for your entry?
sam-oncall: yes, webhook failed with 403 for one of the PD integrations ~6250001089 — "signature mismatch". I rotated my phone earlier today but didn't update PD mobile token? not sure
zara-sre: two separate failure modes then: 1) notify-relay -> pager-gateway 502 (postback retries piling up) 2) PD integration signature mismatch -> PD rejects webhook -> oncall unregistered
kevin-ops: agreed. mitigation plan: (a) disable automated postback retries to stop overload, (b) temporarily disable the PD auto-unregister webhooks so rotation doesn't mark users unregistered, (c) manual ringout for active incidents. can someone run the commands?
maria.dev: i can toggle the retry flag on the relay config. `curl -X PATCH https://relay.internal/config -d '{"postback_retries":0}'` then restart relay pods
zara-sre: doing `kubectl -n notify rollout restart deploy/notify-relay` now. also pushing a quick hotfix to reduce upstream timeout to 30s
pagerflow-bot: alert: notify-relay rollout started by zara-sre. watching pod statuses
kevin-ops: i'll pause the PD auto-unregister hook in the PD integration console (console -> integrations -> webhook -> disable). doing that now :wrench:
sam-oncall: i re-registered my mobile in PD and resent a test page — it came through. good to go on my end
maria.dev: after patch, relay logs show errors dropping and no further 502 spikes, postback queue length decreasing
zara-sre: confirm PD webhook 403s stopped after disabling signing validation for the rotation endpoint. we need to do a proper signing key rotation later
kevin-ops: switching active routing: for active incidents we'll use SMS fallback via `notify-cli --fallback=sms` until PD webhooks fully healthy. manual pages being sent now
incident-bot: note: 5 manual pages sent, 5 acks received from oncall within 2m. automation remains paused
kevin-ops: customer impact estimate: affected region eu-west-1, ~12% of pages delayed >5m during the 20m window; one customer reported delayed paging to SE on outage ticket #INC-1123. no confirmed production impact beyond delayed operator alerting so far
maria.dev: creating an incident ticket and tagging postmortem. action items: 1) root cause triage for postback overload (relay->gateway), 2) improve PD webhook signing UX for rotations, 3) add guardrail to not auto-unregister if webhook returns transient 4xx/5xx streaks, 4) add runbook step to auto-failover to SMS
zara-sre: +1. i'll collect logs and timelines and drop into the ticket. saving `kubectl logs` snippets to the incident folder now
sam-oncall: thumbs up. stay on thread for when automation re-enable is safe :+1:
kevin-ops: will coordinate a controlled re-enable after we validate relay backlog drained and PD webhook health is green. tentative follow-up meeting in 30m
maria.dev: thanks team, keeping this thread as single source of truth. will update when automation turned back on or if we see regressions
kevin-ops: closing the live mitigation loop for now — switching to post-incident mode. Please add any lingering notes to INC-6250 and assign owners
incident-bot: automated: thread closed for live triage; incident ticket INC-6250 created and assigned to kevin-ops, zara-sre for follow-up.
